=== DENTAI AMBIENT CLINICAL NOTE ===
Patient: Emma Watson
Date: 2026-09-15 | Time: 11:00
Procedure: Adult Hygiene Scale & Clean & Fluoride (114, 121)

CHIEF COMPLAINT:
Routine 6-monthly preventive hygiene visit. Mild lower right gingival sensitivity reported.

EXAMINATION & FINDINGS:
Generalized mild marginal gingivitis with localised calculus deposits lower anterior lingual surfaces. No deep periodontal pocketing (>3mm).

TREATMENT PERFORMED:
Full mouth scaling and root debridement using ultrasonic scaler and hand instrumentation (ADA 114). Polishing with fine prophy paste. Topical neutral sodium fluoride gel application for 4 minutes (ADA 121).

POST-OPERATIVE INSTRUCTIONS:
Patient advised nil by mouth for 30 minutes. Gentle brushing with soft-bristled brush recommended.

NEXT VISIT / RECALL:
6 Months Routine Hygiene Recall.

ADA ITEM CODES:
114 (Removal of calculus), 121 (Topical fluoride)
